svg.title: Colored Panels (Red, Yellow, Blue, Green, Violet)
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the actual viewed reference. Approximate observed geometry and standardized color families; wall, shadows, thickness and texture omitted. Partial installation study: five displayed panels of the museum’s stated six-panel work. The sixth panel is not specified or pictured and is not invented. This is the five panels’ observed perspective arrangement in the official auditorium photograph, with all architecture and empty wall transparent; it is not a canonical flat arrangement of the complete work. Individual panels are physically rectangular on different wall planes. Museum component dimensions are retained separately; no aggregate physical size is inferred. Violet is represented by the searchable purple color family. Excluded from true-scale plotting.
